en.headline: Two Tsim Sha Tsui bar staff charged over body removal case appear in court
en.dek: A 28-year-old man and 44-year-old woman face charges including preventing the lawful burial of a corpse after a colleague was found dead on a roadside chair early on Thursday.
body: Two bar staff members charged in connection with the removal of a colleague’s body in Tsim Sha Tsui appeared at Fanling Magistrates’ Courts on Saturday.

Police said a 28-year-old man surnamed Ng and a 44-year-old woman surnamed Cheung were each charged with one count of preventing the lawful burial of a corpse. Each also faces one count of keeping a divan and one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug.

The case stems from the discovery early on Thursday of a 49-year-old man surnamed Lai, also a bar employee, seated lifeless on a chair outside a building on Hanoi Road. Officers later determined that Lai had collapsed inside a nearby upstairs bar on Carnarvon Road and was moved to the street.

During a search of the premises police seized about 50 grams of suspected crack cocaine, drug-taking paraphernalia and roughly HK$82,000 in cash. The cause of Lai’s death remains under investigation pending autopsy results. The two defendants were remanded; further proceedings were adjourned.

zh.headline: 尖沙咀酒吧棄屍案兩職員提堂 各控阻合法埋葬屍體等罪
zh.dek: 28歲男及44歲女酒吧職員被控阻止合法埋葬屍體、經營毒窟及販運危險藥物，周六在粉嶺裁判法院提堂。
body: 涉及尖沙咀一宗棄屍案的兩名酒吧職員，周六在粉嶺裁判法院提堂。
警方指，28歲姓吳男子及44歲姓張女子各被控一項阻止合法埋葬屍體罪，兩人亦分別各被控一項經營毒窟罪及一項販運危險藥物罪。
案情指周四凌晨一名49歲姓黎酒吧男職員被發現在河內道對開電單車位的櫈上昏迷，救護員證實死亡。警方其後調查相信黎男在加拿分道一樓上酒吧內暈倒，被兩名被告搬至街上。
人員在涉案酒吧檢獲約50克懷疑霹靂可卡因、一批吸毒工具及約8.2萬元現金。黎男死因有待解剖確定。兩名被告還押，案件押後再訊。
